name: greater-sanjay
description: Greater Sanjay — universal screen-based control layer for macOS (Cursor Buildathon)
author: Nishtha Singh & Samarth Goyal (https://github.com/igoyalsamarth)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && npm run copy:assets
scripts.watch: concurrently -n main,renderer,assets "tsc -p tsconfig.json -w" "tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json -w" "npm run watch:assets"
scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.dev: npm run copy:assets && concurrently -k -n watch,electron "npm run watch" "wait-on dist/main/main.js && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron ."

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Greater Sanjay needs to control other applications to complete tasks.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureDescription: Greater Sanjay captures screenshots to understand the current UI state.
